thread:
marie_ops: Quick heads-up: planning an APAC-edge maintenance window Wednesday 23:00-00:30 UTC to validate NIC microcode + targeted GPU soft-reboots. Expect intermittent packet drops and up to ~12% capacity reduction in az-apac1 for short bursts.
ajay_infra: What's the execution pattern? full rack drains or per-node soft reboots?
marie_ops: Per-node soft reboot, staggered. We'll do cohorts of 6 nodes, 8min drain + 7min reboot + 5min observation. No full rack cordons. Migration via graceful drain; we'll prefer soft-evac to avoid cold KV flush.
sophie_oncall: Can we do 3 cohorts in parallel max? keep latency-sensitive tenants off those cohorts. I'll add a suppression window for spurious flaps. Paging rotation?
ajay_infra: limit concurrency to 2 cohorts in parallel (to preserve burst capacity). Ajay running cohorts 1-2, Nico covers 3-4. Keep `maxUnavailable=2`.
nico_sre: KV warmup plan: run lightweight prefix replay after each cohort uncordon. Use synthetic probe `probe/warm-keys` at t+2m. Also increase autoscaler headroom +25% for 40m.
marie_ops: Added to checklist. Also we should enable cross-region fallback routing for model-serving for 10m if egress error rate exceeds 1.5% — cheaper but higher tail-latency. Cost hit estimate: ~$45/hr if used.
kate_sales: Please prepare a short comms blurb for enterprise customers in az-apac1 with Dedicated pools. 24h notice preferred.
liam_support: We'll tag customers `region:az-apac1` with `impact:possible`. Support standby from 22:50 UTC. Slack channel for comms?
sophie_oncall: Create a #maint-apac-2026-03-... channel and bridge at 22:55. I'll add the runbook and pager owners.
ajay_infra: Runbook snippet for cordon/drain: ```for node in $(cat cohort-ids.txt); do kubectl cordon $node && ./tools/drain-safe $node --mode=soft; sleep 8m; ssh ops@$node 'reboot -f'; sleep 7m; kubectl uncordon $node; done``` Keep `--ignore-daemonsets` and watch pods with `kubectl get pods -o wide`.
nico_sre: Also ensure NIC driver logging is set to debug for the window and rotate logs post-maintenance. Add `sysctl net.nic.debug=1` to preflight and revert after.
marie_ops: ops-bot, please schedule maintenance ticket and add runbook link.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance CM-5521 by marie_ops for 2026-04-01 23:00 UTC 1:30 duration. Ticket https://infra/tickets/CM-5521
kate_sales: Thx. We'll hold off external comms until ticket has cohort list.
liam_support: If fallback triggers, prioritize Dedicated customers for mitigation and follow our SLA escalation.
sophie_oncall: Preflight at 22:00 UTC for health checks. If any perf regressions in last 24h, cancel.
marie_ops: Agreed. Final note: avoid full cache invalidation. If anyone sees >3% request errors during a cohort, call rollback and stop sequence.
ajay_infra: I'll attach cohort node lists and capacity runway numbers to the ticket.
marie_ops: Great. I'll post 24h comms tomorrow morning and ping security for the audit log retention change. Closing here 1:00 preflight if no objections.
